title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
abstract: Qwen2.5 is a large language model that has been significantly improved during both pre-training and post-training stages, with a strong foundation for common sense, expert knowledge, and reasoning capabilities.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine having a superpower that lets you understand and generate human-like language. That's what Qwen2.5 is all about. By scaling up pre-training data to 18 trillion tokens and using intricate supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, Qwen2.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in various tasks.

You might wonder, what makes Qwen2.5 so special? It's the combination of large-scale pre-training and high-quality fine-tuning that enables the model to develop emergent capabilities in language understanding, generation, and reasoning.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
Qwen2.5 uses a Transformer-based decoder architecture with several key components, including Grouped Query Attention, SwiGLU activation function, and Rotary Positional Embeddings. The model is trained on a massive dataset of over 1 million examples, with a focus on long-sequence generation, mathematical problem-solving, coding, instruction-following, and logical reasoning.

The model's architecture is designed to handle diverse and varied use cases effectively, with a range of model sizes from 0.5B to 72B parameters.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
Qwen2.5 demonstrates top-tier performance on a wide range of benchmarks, including natural language understanding, general question answering, coding, mathematics, scientific knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual capabilities. The model outperforms several open and proprietary models, including Llama-3-405B-Instruct, which is around 5 times larger.

The benchmark results show that Qwen2.5 achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art models, while being more cost-effective and efficient.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
Qwen2.5 has significant implications for the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI). By demonstrating emergent capabilities in language understanding, generation, and reasoning, Qwen2.5 shows that large language models can achieve significant breakthroughs in scientific exploration.

The model's ability to handle diverse and varied use cases effectively makes it a valuable tool for a wide range of applications, from natural language processing to computer vision and robotics.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
Qwen2.5 introduces several key innovations, including the use of Grouped Query Attention, SwiGLU activation function, and Rotary Positional Embeddings. The model also uses a two-phase pre-training approach, with an initial phase with a 4,096-token context length, followed by an extension phase for longer sequences.

The model's architecture and training pipeline are designed to handle diverse and varied use cases effectively, making it a valuable tool for a wide range of applications.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
Qwen2.5 is available for use through the Hugging Face Hub, ModelScope, and Kaggle. You can access the model and experiment with it using the provided APIs and tools.

Try using Qwen2.5 for your own projects and applications, and see how it can help you achieve your goals.
